title: NullPointerException in NetworkManager when connection drops during file download
description: The NetworkManager crashes with NullPointerException when a network connection drops mid-download. The retry handler attempts to access a null connection object. Steps: 1. Start large file download 2. Disconnect network 3. Observe crash in retry logic. Expected: Graceful error handling. Actual: JVM crash with NPE.
resolution: Fixed by adding null check before accessing connection object in retry handler. Added defensive null checks throughout the connection lifecycle management code.

title: Memory leak in tab rendering engine when switching tabs rapidly
description: When switching between tabs rapidly (10+ times per second), the rendering engine accumulates unreleased render contexts leading to continuous memory growth. After 30 minutes of rapid switching, memory usage grows by 2GB+. Expected: Stable memory usage. Actual: Unbounded memory growth.
resolution: Implemented proper cleanup of render contexts in tab switch handler. Added reference counting and weak references for render cache entries.

title: Segmentation fault in WebGL renderer with unsupported shader operations
description: WebGL context crashes with segfault when attempting to use unsupported shader operations on older GPU drivers. The renderer does not validate shader capabilities before execution. Expected: Graceful fallback. Actual: Browser crash.
resolution: Added shader capability validation before execution in WebGL context. Implemented fallback rendering path for unsupported operations.

title: CSS Grid layout miscalculation with auto-fit and minmax constraints
description: CSS Grid with auto-fit tracks and minmax() constraints produces incorrect column widths when container width is between breakpoints. The constraint solver does not properly handle the interaction between auto-fit and minmax. Expected: Correct column widths. Actual: Columns overflow container.
resolution: Fixed constraint solving algorithm for auto-fit tracks with minmax functions. Added special case handling for boundary conditions.

title: StackOverflowError in recursive XML parser with deeply nested elements
description: The XML parser uses recursive descent parsing which causes StackOverflowError when processing XML documents with nesting depth > 10000. This is exploitable as a denial-of-service vector. Expected: Handle deep nesting. Actual: JVM crash with StackOverflowError.
resolution: Converted recursive parser to iterative approach with explicit stack. Added configurable maximum nesting depth with graceful error reporting.

title: Race condition in thread pool causing deadlock under high concurrency
description: Under high concurrency (1000+ simultaneous requests), the thread pool enters a deadlock state due to improper lock ordering between the task queue and worker thread management. All request processing halts. Expected: Handle concurrent load. Actual: Complete server freeze.
resolution: Added proper lock ordering and timeout mechanism to prevent deadlock. Implemented lock-free task queue with CAS operations.

title: Buffer overflow in HTTP header parsing with malformed Content-Type
description: Malformed Content-Type headers with extremely long values cause a buffer overflow in the HTTP header parser. This is a security vulnerability (CVE-worthy). Expected: Reject malformed headers. Actual: Buffer overflow leading to potential code execution.
resolution: Implemented bounds checking and input validation for all header fields. Added maximum header size limits and proper error responses for malformed input.

title: Connection leak in connection pool when exception occurs during checkout
description: When an exception occurs during connection checkout from the pool, the connection is not returned to the pool. Over time, all connections are leaked and the application cannot process new requests. Expected: Return connection on failure. Actual: Connection leak leading to pool exhaustion.
resolution: Added try-finally block to ensure connection return on checkout failure. Implemented connection pool health monitoring and automatic recovery.

title: ClassCastException when refactoring generic types in JDT compiler
description: The JDT compiler throws ClassCastException when performing type refactoring on code using complex generic type hierarchies. The type resolution algorithm does not properly handle type erasure in nested generics. Expected: Correct refactoring. Actual: Compiler crash.
resolution: Added type erasure handling in generic type resolution algorithm. Implemented proper bounds checking for generic type parameters.

title: UI freeze when opening large workspace with 500+ projects
description: Opening a workspace with 500+ projects causes the Eclipse UI to freeze for 5+ minutes. The workspace loading runs on the UI thread blocking all user interaction. Expected: Responsive UI during load. Actual: Complete UI freeze.
resolution: Moved workspace loading to background thread with progress reporting. Implemented incremental project loading with lazy initialization.

title: IndexOutOfBoundsException in code completion with partial token matching
description: Code completion crashes with IndexOutOfBoundsException when the user types partial tokens that match no completions. The token matching algorithm assumes at least one match exists. Expected: Show no results. Actual: Editor crash.
resolution: Added boundary checks in token matching algorithm and fallback for empty results. Implemented graceful degradation when no completions match.

title: Deadlock in plugin activation when circular dependencies exist
description: When plugins have circular activation dependencies, the plugin framework enters a deadlock during workspace startup. The activation monitor waits indefinitely for circular dependencies to resolve. Expected: Detect and break cycles. Actual: Permanent startup hang.
resolution: Implemented dependency graph cycle detection with topological sort ordering. Added timeout-based deadlock prevention with diagnostic logging.
